description: Locked outdoor evaluation panel: eight sources each from FrodoBots, Ego4D, Sekai, and SpatialVID.
selection_protocol: Frozen before mixed-panel model generation. FrodoBots uses every fourth item from the preregistered 32-context order beginning at index 0. Ego4D uses exactly eight visibly outdoor clips selected by manual inspection from 40 individually downloaded official project-page previews. Sekai uses four outdoor-natural and four outdoor-urban Walking-HQ rows selected only from official annotations, with only the six-second source ranges downloaded. SpatialVID uses exactly eight visibly outdoor individually downloadable official project-page samples. Selection used source provenance, official annotations where available, and outdoor visibility only; no candidate model outputs or evaluation scores existed or were inspected.
